property_summary: For any play() call that enters the payout branch, the total Ether leaving the contract must equal the pot accumulated before payout, so address(c).balance can never decrease by more than the pre-call pot; the mutant pays the player the full pot plus the bank fee, so the contract's balance drops by pot + FEE_AMOUNT on such an input.
change_summary: Transfer the full pot to the player, changing the payout amount.
